gradeRationale.note: The strain, not the category, is the subject. Any policy citing this claim must therefore resolve to products containing THIS strain - which is only possible because probiotic strains are modelled as compounds.

statement: Specific probiotic strains including Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG reduce the incidence of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea; the effect is strain-specific and does not generalise to probiotics as a category.

citations.title: World Gastroenterology Organisation Global Guideline: Probiotics and Prebiotics
